steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each lead source is placed by its rejection rate and whether it produces opportunities.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 lead source rejects more than 40 percent

findings.title: Source with leads and no opportunities

outcome.notChecked: Why leads were rejected beyond the recorded reason; quality of sales follow-up.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

       Fix: Review the source's targeting.

       Fix: Record the reason.
[low] source-web.csv:26  Source with leads and no opportunities.

Not checked: Why leads were rejected beyond the recorded reason; quality of sales follow-up.
pros: Checks a source with a rejection rate above 40 percent; a rejection with a blank reason; a source with leads and no opportunities over the period.
cons: Not checked: Why leads were rejected beyond the recorded reason; quality of sales follow-up.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mkt-lead-quality skill on the records for this review.
